items.promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文讲述高中生李华暑假在医院做志愿者的经历，这段经历坚定了他学医的梦想。
explanation.ruleZh: 语法填空要先看句子结构与时间状语：过去时间用过去式，比较结构用比较级，介词后用代词宾格，冠词看读音，括号内提示词按句法要求变形。

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: who 指代 a senior high school student，从句描述现在的身份与理想，主语为第三人称单数，故填 dreams。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: Last summer 是明确的过去时间，谓语动词用过去式 spent。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 填冠词
gaps.explanationZh: hospital 是可数名词单数，此处泛指“一家医院”，且以辅音音素开头，填 a。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 with 后接人称代词宾格，填 them。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 much 和后面的 than 可知用比较级，填 warmer。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 填冠词
gaps.explanationZh: important 以元音音素开头，表示“一堂重要的课”用 an。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 空后是名词 day，需要所有格形式 someone's，表示“某个人的（一天）”。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: make up one's mind to do sth 表示“下决心做某事”，填 to study。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 句意为“如果他一直努力，梦想就会实现”，条件状语从句填 if。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内代词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 of 后接人称代词宾格，填 him。

gaps.explanationZh: books 与 put 之间是被动关系，描述经常性情况，填 are put（用 have been put 也可以）。

gaps.label: 第3空

gaps.explanationZh: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语，填 chatting。

gaps.explanationZh: 此处用动词不定式作目的状语，表示“为了让图书馆更友好”，填 to make。

gaps.label: 第10空

gaps.explanationZh: 主语 we 与 smile 是主动关系，用现在分词作伴随状语，填 smiling。

items.promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文说明中学生睡眠不足的现象，并给出规律作息、远离手机和适当午休三条建议。

gaps.explanationZh: eight 后接可数名词复数，填 hours。

gaps.explanationZh: or 连接与 playing 并列的动名词，填 chatting。

gaps.clue: 填代词

gaps.explanationZh: “the more..., the less...”是固定比较结构，填 less。

gaps.label: 第6空

gaps.label: 第9空

gaps.label: 第10空

gaps.label: 第10空

items.promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文介绍中国高铁的发展速度及其给人们出行和小城市带来的变化。
explanation.ruleZh: Today 配一般现在时；So far 配现在完成时被动语态；per/an hour 表速度；形容词、动词需按词形转换规则变形。

evidence.quote: Today, the high-speed railway ____ (cover) the same distance in about four and a half hours
A fruit farmer in Anhui said his peaches used to go bad

segments.text: Ten years ago,
took almost a whole day to travel from Beijing to Shanghai by train. Today, the high-speed railway
(cover) the same distance in about four and a half hours. So far, more than 40,000 kilometers of high-speed lines
(build) across the country, and trains now run at a speed of 350 kilometers
hour. Passengers can buy tickets
(easy) through an app and enter the station with a scan of their faces instead of waiting in long queues. The railway has also brought
(visit) and business to smaller cities along the lines. A fruit farmer in Anhui said his peaches used to go bad
they reached the city market, but now they
(sell) to customers hundreds of kilometers away within hours instead of two days. To make future travel even better, engineers are testing
(fast) trains that may run at 600 kilometers per hour, and experts believe greater
(convenient) will make more people choose trains over planes.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 填代词
gaps.explanationZh: “it takes/took + 时间 + to do sth”句型中 it 作形式主语，填 it。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: Today 与一般现在时连用，主语 the railway 为第三人称单数，填 covers。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: So far 常与现在完成时连用，lines 与 build 是被动关系，填 have been built。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 填介词或冠词
gaps.explanationZh: 表示速度“每小时 350 公里”，填 per 或 an（an hour）。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内副词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 修饰动词 buy 用副词 easily。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 用括号内名词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: brought 后接名词作宾语，表示“游客”且不止一人，填 visitors。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 句意为“桃子在运到城里市场之前就变质了”，填 before。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: they 指代 peaches，与 sell 是被动关系，一般现在时填 are sold。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 用括号内形容词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 与现有列车相比速度更快，用比较级 faster。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 形容词 great 后接名词作 believe 后从句的主语，convenient 的名词形式为 convenience。

items.promptZh: 阅读短文，在空白处填入 1 个适当的单词或括号内单词的正确形式。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文描写学校篮球决赛中，替补的小队员临危受命、连得关键分数反败为胜的过程。
explanation.ruleZh: was crowded with、would lose 过去将来时、to one's surprise、making 结果状语和 what 引导的宾语从句是本题考点。

evidence.quote: the coach had no choice but ____ (take) him off
The moment the whistle sounded, the whole class rushed onto the playground

segments.text: Last Friday afternoon, our school held its yearly basketball final against Sunshine School. When the match began, the playground
(crowd) with excited students. Neither team
(score) in the first five minutes, and the game was full of tension and excitement. Halfway through the second half, our best player fell and hurt his knee
(bad), so the coach had no choice but
(take) him off. At that moment, almost everyone in the crowd thought we
(lose) the match. However, the youngest player,
had joined the team only a month before, stepped forward calmly. He shot the ball from far away, and to everyone's
(surprised), it went in. Then, in the very last minute of the game, he scored again,
(make) the final score 58 to 57. The moment the whistle sounded, the whole class rushed onto the playground,
(cheer) at the top of their voices. Our headmaster said afterwards that the players had shown us
real teamwork means.

gaps.label: 第1空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: be crowded with 表示“挤满”，主语 the playground 为过去时单数，填 was crowded。

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 描述过去进行的比赛，用过去式 scored。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 用括号内副词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 修饰动词 hurt 用副词 badly。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: have no choice but to do sth 表示“别无选择只能做某事”，填 to take。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 主句 thought 是过去时，从句表示“将会输”，用过去将来时 would lose。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句修饰 the youngest player，从句缺主语，填 who。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: to one's surprise 为固定短语，填名词 surprise。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 现在分词作结果状语，表示自然而然的结果，填 making。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 主语 class 与 cheer 是主动关系，用现在分词作伴随状语，填 cheering。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 宾语从句中 means 缺宾语，表示“……的东西”，填 what。

explanation.summaryZh: 短文赞美英语高老师十五年如一日用新点子教英语，帮助学生不怕犯错、爱上英语。
explanation.ruleZh: for/since 时间状语配完成时，although 引导让步从句，more carefully 为副词比较级，which 引导非限制性定语从句。

evidence.quote: my spoken English ____ (improve) a lot since last September
Although she checks our homework ____ (careful) than any other teacher, she never blames us

segments.text: Miss Gao
(teach) English at our school for fifteen years, but she still prepares every class with fresh ideas and often stays late marking papers.
she has taught some lessons many times, her classes are never boring;
, she always finds new ways to make us think. Last term, she started an English corner after class, where students practice
(speak) by describing pictures, telling stories and acting out short dialogues in English. She often says that making mistakes is an important part of
(learn), so nobody should be afraid of them. Although she checks our homework
(careful) than any other teacher, she never blames us. When we make the same mistake again, she simply explains it one
(many) time with a smile. Thanks to her help, my spoken English
(improve) a lot since last September, and I am no longer afraid of opening my mouth. Under her influence, I have fallen in love with English,
I once hated most. I believe I
(remember) her for a long time.

gaps.label: 第2空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 引导让步状语从句表示“尽管”，填 Although/Even though/Though。

gaps.label: 第3空
gaps.clue: 填副词
gaps.explanationZh: 分号后表示“相反/然而”，填 instead 或 however。

gaps.label: 第4空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: practice doing sth 表示“练习做某事”，填 speaking。

gaps.label: 第5空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 介词 of 后接动名词，填 learning。

gaps.label: 第6空
gaps.clue: 用括号内副词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 由 than any other teacher 可知用副词比较级 more carefully。

gaps.label: 第7空
gaps.clue: 用括号内词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: one more time 表示“再一次”，填 more。

gaps.label: 第8空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: since last September 与现在完成时连用，填 has improved。

gaps.label: 第9空
gaps.clue: 填连词
gaps.explanationZh: 非限制性定语从句指代 English，从句中 hated 缺宾语，填 which。

gaps.label: 第10空
gaps.clue: 用括号内动词的适当形式
gaps.explanationZh: 表示将来的信念，用一般将来时 will remember。
